# Database Schema {.unnumbered}

Provided here is the SQLite schema behind [Database Structure](database-structure.qmd).

Source: [`db/schema.py`](https://github.com/oliverdsiu/ods-log/blob/main/db/schema.py)

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
    ASSET_TYPES ||--o{ ASSETS : "categorizes"
    ASSET_TYPES ||--o{ ASSET_TYPE_TEMPLATES : "has"
    SERVICE_TYPES ||--o{ ASSET_TYPE_TEMPLATES : "has"
    ASSETS ||--o{ ASSET_RETIREMENTS : "has"
    ASSETS ||--o{ ASSET_SCHEDULE : "has"
    SERVICE_TYPES ||--o{ ASSET_SCHEDULE : "has"
    ASSETS ||--o{ SERVICE_LOGS : "has"
    SERVICE_TYPES ||--o{ SERVICE_LOGS : "has"
    COMPANIES ||--o{ SERVICE_LOGS : "performed by"
    TECHNICIANS ||--o{ SERVICE_LOGS : "performed by"
    ASSETS ||--o{ USAGE_LOGS : "has"
    COMPANIES ||--o{ TECHNICIANS : "employs"

    ASSET_TYPES {
        int id PK
        string name
        string usage_type
        string status
    }
    ASSETS {
        int id PK
        string name
        string make
        string model
        int year
        int asset_type_id FK
        string fuel_type
        string color
        real current_usage
        string status
        string notes
        date created_at
        string serial_number
        string license_plate
        date purchase_date
        real purchase_price
    }
    ASSET_RETIREMENTS {
        int id PK
        int asset_id FK
        date retire_date
        real retire_price
        string retire_reason
        string retire_notes
        string status
    }
    SERVICE_TYPES {
        int id PK
        string name
        string status
    }
    ASSET_TYPE_TEMPLATES {
        int id PK
        int asset_type_id FK
        int service_type_id FK
        real usage_interval
        real time_interval
        string time_type
        real usage_reminder
        int time_reminder
        string notes
        string status
    }
    ASSET_SCHEDULE {
        int id PK
        int asset_id FK
        int service_type_id FK
        real usage_interval
        real time_interval
        string time_type
        real usage_reminder
        int time_reminder
        date last_done_date
        real last_done_usage
        date next_due_date
        real next_due_usage
        string notes
        string status
    }
    COMPANIES {
        int id PK
        string name
        bool is_internal
        string status
    }
    TECHNICIANS {
        int id PK
        string first_name
        string middle_name
        string last_name
        int company_id FK
        string status
    }
    SERVICE_LOGS {
        int id PK
        int asset_id FK
        int service_type_id FK
        date date
        real usage_at_service
        real cost
        string currency
        int company_id FK
        int technician_id FK
        string notes
        string status
    }
    USAGE_LOGS {
        int id PK
        int asset_id FK
        date date
        real odometer
        real fuel_amount
        string fuel_unit
        string fuel_type
        real fuel_cost
        string currency
        string notes
        string status
    }
```

Every table above carries a `status` column (`Active` / `Archived`). OdsLog uses nondestructive archiving and does not hard-delete records from the database.

A `metadata` key/value table also exists, omitted from the diagram above since it has no foreign-key relationships to the rest of the schema. Every row's `value` is stored as text regardless of its logical type. The boolean and numeric fields below are literal `"true"`/`"10"` strings, not native SQLite types.

| Key | Holds |
|:---|:---|
| `company_name` | Your company/operation name |
| `schema_version` | Schema version the database was created with |
| `app_version` | OdsLog version used to create database |
| `created_at` | Database creation date |
| `default_currency` | Default currency for new logs |
| `default_fuel_unit` | Default fuel unit for usage logs |
| `due_soon_threshold_pct` | Percentage used by the Dashboard's due-soon calculation |
| `fiscal_year_start` | Fiscal year start date (`MM-DD`) |
| `clear_archived_logs_on_close` | Whether archived logs should be purged when the database closes (not yet enforced) |
